title: Compatible residue embedding after etale localization is a separable closure
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring, and let $K$ be a separable closure of its residue field [def-kun-separably-closed]. Let $t=(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$ be a pointed etale residue triple over its closed point [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples]. Let $A=B_q$ be any realization of its localization, with its local-ring structure. Suppose $\chi_A:\kappa(A)\to K$ satisfies $\chi_A\circ(A\to\kappa(A))\circ(B\to A)=\phi\circ(B\to\kappa(q))$. Then $\chi_A$ makes $K$ a separable closure of $\kappa(A)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 04GW (lemma-strict-henselization-different), residue-field embeddings, with separability in towers

proof.text: Write $\eta_R:R\to\kappa(R)$ and $\eta_A:A\to\kappa(A)$ for the canonical evaluation maps. Triple compatibility and the displayed equality give $\chi_A\gamma=\iota\eta_R$, where $\gamma=\eta_A\circ(B\to A)\circ\alpha$ and $\iota$ is the original embedding into $K$. As $\chi_A$ is injective, $\ker\eta_R\subseteq\ker\gamma$.

The map $\eta_R$ is surjective: identify the scheme residue field with the ideal residue field at the maximal ideal of the local ring, whose canonical map from $R$ is surjective. RingHom.liftOfSurjective therefore descends $\gamma$ to $j:\kappa(R)\to\kappa(A)$, with $j\eta_R=\gamma$. This map is uniquely determined by the displayed equality. Surjectivity of $\eta_R$ gives $\chi_Aj=\iota$.

The equality $\chi_Aj=\iota$ gives a scalar tower of the three fields. Mathlibs Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable gives separability of $K$ over $\kappa(A)$ from its separability over $\kappa(R)$. Its separable closedness is unchanged. These are the two fields of IsSepClosure, proving the assertion. The zero ring case is excluded by the local-ring structures; the identity triple gives the original separable closure.

theorem etale_localization_separable_closure
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing R]
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K]
    [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K]
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) K
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
        ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K)))
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra t.B A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A t.q.asIdeal]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    (χA : (Spec A).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (hχA : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap t.B A) ≫ (ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫
      (Spec A).Γevaluation (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) ≫ χA =
      (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ)
 :
    letI : Algebra ((Spec A).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) K :=
      χA.hom.toAlgebra
    IsSepClosure ((Spec A).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) K
